description: Solve a Google reCAPTCHA v2 (checkbox, then image grid or audio) and capture v3 tokens. Clicks the checkbox with real pointer moves; on an image grid it classifies the tiles with a configured vision endpoint (APPIUM_MCP_CAPTCHA_VLM_URL, or the claude-local hunch config), or — when no endpoint is configured — by asking the MCP client model through sampling, then presses the matching tiles, verifies, and re-solves each new round until a token appears. Without either source it returns a PNG plus every tile box as `needs_answer`; `tiles`/`tilesScript` override it. Retries a rejected grid up to 5 times in 90 s and maps "challenge expired", "Try again later" and anchor alerts to typed failures. Audio is captured and handed to an external transcription hook. v3 is always reported "unverified — no score assertion". Live demo: https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v2-checkbox.php; v3 demo: https://recaptcha-demo.appspot.com/recaptcha-v3-verify.php.

audio.description: Prefer the audio challenge instead of the image grid. Without audioScript the clip URL is returned for the caller.

audioScript.description: JS run inside the challenge frame with { url, attempt }; downloads/transcribes the audio clip and returns the text. The tool fills #audio-response and presses verify.

frame.description: Frame override for the anchor when auto-discovery is ambiguous (index or URL substring, from playwright_frames).

maxMs.description: Wall-clock cap for the whole call (default 90000).

mode.description: Challenge kind. "auto" (default) uses v2 when an anchor iframe exists and v3 when only grecaptcha is exposed. "v2" covers checkbox, image grid and the audio fallback. "v3" is passive: it executes and returns a token, never a pass.

sitekey.description: reCAPTCHA sitekey, needed only for v3/invisible where it cannot be read from the page. Google test keys: v2 always passes 6LeIxAcTAAAAAJcZVRqyHh71UMIEGNQ_MXjiZKhI; v2 always challenges 6LeIxAcTAAAAAGG-vFI1TnRWxMZNFuojJ4WifJWe; v3 uses the first.

tiles.description: Tile indices (0-based, row-major) to press for the current grid image. Usually taken from a previous call that returned the challenge and `needs_answer`.

tilesScript.description: JS run inside the challenge frame with { image, width, height, tiles, prompt, attempt }. Understands the returned capture and presses the chosen tiles, and may return an array of tile indices instead (the tool then presses them). It should press #recaptcha-verify-button when it is done pressing; returning an array makes the tool press tiles and verify. The loop captures again after a rejected selection, up to 5 retries.

verifyMs.description: How long to wait for a token after a press (default 8000).

vision.description: Solve image grids with the configured vision endpoint (or MCP sampling when no endpoint is configured) instead of returning them as `needs_answer`. Default: on when APPIUM_MCP_CAPTCHA_VLM_URL, a claude-local hunch config, or a sampling-capable MCP client is present; this option set to false disables them. With APPIUM_MCP_CAPTCHA_HUNCH=1 the hunch judge runs first and falls back to the vision path. A caller-supplied `tiles`/`tilesScript` still wins.

visionMs.description: Timeout for one vision classification call (default 45000).

name: playwright_captcha_recaptcha
